payout_quote: Official Spreadshop: 'Open your free shop. No fees for opening or running your print-on-demand shop.' 'You set your own margins and determine your profits.' 'Your Base Price: Each product has a prefixed price before you sell it. $15 for a t-shirt, $12 for a cap, etc. Your Margin: Anything you set beyond the base price goes into your pocket. How much you earn is up to you! Your Retail Price: Base price + margin.' And: 'With every sale, the Affiliate Commission pays you 20% of the sum of product type price and print price.'
steps: Open a free Spreadshop (no fees to open or run).
Upload designs; customize 300+ products; set your own margins above the base price.
Share your shop; Spreadshop prints and ships on demand.
Earn your set margin per sale, plus 20% affiliate commission where applicable.
catches: Your margin is whatever you add above Spreadshop's base price — set it too high and customers won't buy; too low and you earn pennies.
The 20% affiliate commission applies to the product+print price, not your margin.
Highly variable; most shop owners earn little; income depends on designs, traffic, and marketing.
You must own the rights to uploaded designs.
biggest_catch: You set your own margin, but Spreadshop's base price ($15 for a tee, etc.) anchors the retail price — your profit is only what you dare to add above it, and with no guaranteed traffic most shops earn little.
eligibility: 18+; original designs you have rights to.
timing: Commissions paid per Spreadshop's payout schedule.
